cues.text: Watch F1 Finance's accounting machine reconcile October's payroll for HANGS Construction.
First it recomputes both payroll registers, employee by employee.
Next it ties October's payroll cost, about $193,000, to the ledger and to the bank.
A register is the list of every paycheck.
Then payroll taxes, recomputed and tied to the deposits.
Then union dues, benefits and garnishments: wages withheld by court order.
One garnishment payment was never sent to the agency.
And an employee who had left was still paid.
It proposes three small entries, about $3,000 in all, including overtime paid at the regular rate.
All done. October payroll ties to the ledger and the bank, with three exceptions for a person. Nothing was posted and no payroll was changed; the controller approves each entry.
Jumping to the results. A person still reviews every item before anything is posted, paid or sent.
